_comment: Build menu: the categories of the original's build menu with their buildings, in order (lists as in JSettlers' EBuildingsCategory, MIT). Buildings a people does not have are left out. tab: GUI images (file 03, large size) of the category button, normal and selected.
_panelTabsComment: The main tabs below the minimap (GUI images of file 03: [normal, pressed], drawn over the blue panel where its own tabs are) and the sub-menus in the dark bar below them (the build tab uses buildMenu). The sub-menus are only placeholders for now.
_soldiersMenuComment: Siedler > Krieger: GUI images of file 03 for the upgrade buttons per soldier type ([plain, plain dark, upgraded, upgraded dark]) and the arrows ([double up, up, down, double down]); weapon squares of the people's file for the recruitment rows.
_textButtonComment: Wide text buttons (Abreißen, Ja/Nein, the statistics screen …): the stone buttons of the original's menus before the game, GUI image 0 of file 02 (a sheet) – source rectangles [x, y, width, height] of the button up and pressed; border: the frame kept unstretched. statisticsBackground: the blue marble (GUI image of file 02).
_titleScreenComment: Title screen: the Gold Edition's main menu picture per language (file 61, GUI 1 German, 2 English; 800 × 600), beside it a plain gold strip [x, y, width, height] of GUI image 0; popup: the message box of the menus before the game ([file, GUI image], 401 × 201: text area, marble for the buttons below).
_settingsScreenComment: Settings screen: a background of the original's menus (file 02, GUI 14, 800 × 600: four small boxes and a title field at the top, a large dark area, a note field at the bottom), marble beside it (GUI 29); tabs in the four boxes: icons of the original's statistics menus ([bright, dark] GUI images of tabs.file).
_campaignScreenComment: Campaign: choosing the people on the original's background (file 02, GUI 7, 800 × 600: the three helmets, per people a picture and a dark field below it for the name, a field for the heading at the top), marble beside it (GUI 29) – [x, y, width, height].
_missionScreenComment: Campaign: choosing a mission once one is accomplished, on the original's background (file 02, GUI 18, 800 × 600: a field for the heading, a large dark area for the list), marble beside it – [x, y, width, height].
_startScreenComment: Start screen on the original's map selection background: GUI images of file 02 – background (800 × 600, list, slanted preview window, panel), marble around it, rowBar (stone bar under the selected row), scroll bar groove (top, track, bottom); from the sheet (GUI image 0) the oval button up and pressed and the scroll handle – [x, y, width, height].
_professionsMenuComment: Siedler > Berufe: GUI images of file 03 – the up/down spinner of the shares, the find buttons ([all on the map, all on the screen, the next one]) and the convert buttons ([5, 1]).
_transportMenuComment: Waren > Warentransport: GUI images of file 03 for the buttons below the goods: store, do not store, highest priority, +1, -1, lowest priority.
_distributionMenuComment: Waren > Verteilung: the goods at the left, in this order; only those with at least two kinds of user for the people (construction sites, building types taking it) are shown.
_goodsGridComment: Siedler > Produktion, Waren > Lagerbestand: the goods, row by row, with their GUI icon ([file, index], the large size – from JSettlers' EMaterialType, MIT, whose base index is the small one; weapon: the people's own from soldiersMenu) and German name. Goods the people cannot make are dark.
_portraitsComment: Unit portraits in the stone frame (GUI images of the people's file, the large 40x60 one; the medium and small are the two before it), by animation type; WORKER: the specialists (Fachleute), THIEF: scout. From the carrier on the same distance in every file (digger +3, builder +6, worker +18, thief +51, geologist +54, healer +63, priest +69 – Asians +75, pioneer +72 – missing for Egyptians). soldiers: the first, then swordsman, pikeman, bowman of level 1, the same of level 2 and 3, three images apart. common: the same for every people (file 03, or [file, index]); FRAME: an empty frame, behind the figure of kinds without a portrait.
_settlersOverviewComment: Siedler > Siedlerstatistik: icons of file 03 for room (house), settlers needing room (hammer) and the total (arrow); the soldiers' icon is the people's sword (soldiersMenu.weapons). rows: the portraits below, by animation type.
_statusComment: Building info panel: the simulation's status text mapped to the key of the state shown (buildingStatus.* in data/lang). The first entry whose text is contained in the status wins; anything else counts as active. Military buildings show their soldiers instead.
